title: arrhenatherum newtonii
intro: Arrhenatherum newtonii, commonly known as Newton's needle grass, is a species of grass native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Newton's needle grass include its ability to act as an anti-spasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Arrhenatherum newtonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
